title: Signature and seal side by side

rows.subject: Legal effect
rows.common: QES = handwritten signature (equivalence). Qualified seal = PRESUMPTION of integrity and origin.
rows.difference: MAJOR DIFFERENCE - not a true mirror image. Only the signature is placed on an equal footing with the handwritten signature.

rows.subject: Advanced form
rows.common: Both: (a) unique linkage, (b) identification, (c) control over the creation data, (d) detectability of any subsequent change.
rows.difference: Fine difference in point (c): Article 26 requires SOLE control, Article 36 only 'under its control'.

rows.subject: Public services
rows.common: Obligation to accept the listed forms, prohibition of excessive requirements, implementing act on reference formats.
rows.difference: Completely mirror-symmetrical. Both have a deleted paragraph 4.

rows.subject: Qualified certificates
rows.common: Compliance with the annex, no additional requirements, optional attributes, definitive revocation, national suspension rules.
rows.difference: Difference only in the annexes: Annex I permits a pseudonym, Annex III requires the name and, where applicable, the registration number of the creator of the seal.

rows.subject: Creation devices
rows.common: Article 39 refers to Articles 29, 30 and 31 and, mutatis mutandis, to Annex II.
rows.difference: A pure referring provision - no separate annex for seal creation devices.

rows.subject: Remote management service
rows.common: Article 39a refers in full to Article 29a.
rows.difference: The transitional period under Article 51(3) applies to BOTH until 21 May 2026.

rows.subject: Certification of the devices
rows.common: Certification by designated bodies, max. 5 years where a vulnerability assessment is carried out every two years.
rows.difference: A single joint certification may cover signature and seal where the same hardware is used.

rows.subject: List of certified devices
rows.common: Notification within one month, the Commission maintains the list.

rows.subject: Validation (qualified)
rows.common: Eight check points (a)-(h); Article 40 refers to Articles 32, 33 and 34.

rows.subject: Validation (AdES based on a qualified certificate)
rows.common: Seven check points (a)-(g) - the QSCD condition of Article 32(1)(f) is missing.
rows.difference: EXAM TRAP: 32 has eight, 32a has seven points.

rows.subject: Validation service
rows.common: Only by a QTSP; result confirmed with an ADVANCED electronic signature or an advanced electronic seal.
rows.difference: Advanced is sufficient - unlike the archiving report under Article 45j(1)(d), which must be qualified.

rows.subject: Preservation service
rows.common: Extension of trustworthiness beyond the technological validity period.

check.verdict: clean - no defects found; 12 rows, order and columns match the German source, all article/annex/paragraph numbers and the date 21 May 2026 are correct, glossary terms and the one quoted phrase ('under its control', Art. 36(c)) match the official English
